source_quotes.quote: This survey examines the stronger problem of generalized schema-guided extraction: discovering sources, traversing unfamiliar sites, populating typed records with field-level provenance, and assembling a validated dataset without site-specific redevelopment.

We propose a multi-level evaluation framework and ground it in a controlled 108-run case study crossing three agent architectures, three LLM backends, four frozen commerce sites, and three repetitions.
